han_weak_grades: 6.4.37 deletes the final nasal before a qualifying jhal-initial kit/ṅit ending. 6.4.98 deletes the upadhā before a qualifying vowel-initial kit/ṅit ending; 7.3.54 then gives the inherited gh before the nasal. These are distinct conditions, not blanket deletion of every n.
anusvara: 8.3.24 supplies the nonfinal anusvāra in haṃsi; it is distinct from ṇatva.
nasal_visibility: The inner ni-n becomes ṇ under 8.4.17. That intervening ṇ is outside the permitted interveners of 8.4.2; do not transfer the single-prefix pra+han nasal options at 8.4.22/23 to these ordered inner-ni forms. The root nasal stays dental in praṇihanmi/praṇihanvaḥ/praṇihanmaḥ.
imperfect: Retain the non-today past premise, without māṅ. The augment precedes the root inside the two preverbs; second and third singular praṇyahan coincide but remain different person-number keys.
cutting: Retain the śyan stem sy- and the inherited 8.3.63/65 initial ṣ. The present/imperfect short stem is distinct from the future sāsy-.
domain: The four inherited, sense-qualified ordered pra+ni / pari+ni P profiles. Unaccented Classical pause forms; no A-pada or yaṅ-luk expansion.
observed_and_composed: The independent lexical contrasts and ordered preverb witnesses in PG274 are inherited by exact source pins. The new person-number schedules are rule-backed written compositions; 24 bare archived cells are literal comparisons, not 48 new manuscript attestations. No new independently counted source observations or nominal positions are claimed.
